title: Generalized nearby cycles via relative and logarithmic $\mathscr{D}$-modules
authors: with an appendix by Claude Sabbah
summary: For a regular map $F$ from a complex smooth affine variety $X$ to $\mathbb A^r_\mathbb C$, we construct generalized nearby-cycle modules of a regular holonomic $\mathscr D$-module $\mathcal M$ along log strata with the log structure induced by the graph of $F$, whose relative supports are infinite unions of translated linear subvarieties of $\mathbb C^r$ determined by the zero loci of Bernstein-Sato ideals along monoid ideals.
